companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: SmartRecruiters is the Recruiting AI Company that transforms hiring for the world’s leading enterprises. Built for global scale, SmartRecruiters, an SAP company, delivers an AI-powered hiring platform that automates and optimizes the entire talent acquisition process, ensuring faster and smarter hiring decisions. jobDescription.text:
Our Product and Engineering (R&D) org consists of 500+ professionals, organized in Groups and Squads, coming from two different companies and using different ways of working. We are seeking Engineering Operations Managers to join a dedicated team supporting our organization, processes, and tooling. If you are passionate about continuous improvements and operational excellence, impact driven organizational and process design, execution, data and insights, we want to hear from you.

qualifications.text:

  • In-depth understanding of modern development patterns, practices and tools used in software and digital product development
